$comment: Checks the structure of the values (maps where the templates expect maps, scalars where they expect scalars) and rejects unknown keys of the chart's own maps (e.g., typos). Scalars are of any scalar type, as tools may set strings, except for the switches ingress.enabled and transfer.enabled (booleans) and values with ranges. Open on purpose: the maps with Kubernetes' fields (tesk.podSecurityContext, tesk.securityContext, the probes, the resource lists of tesk.resources, ingress.annotations), as in foca-common, and global and enabled, which Helm and parent charts (condition: tesk.enabled) set. Keys of earlier versions of the chart ($defs/removed) pass here, and fail in the templates with their replacements (see tesk.removedValues in templates/_helpers.tpl)

map.$comment: A string (e.g., empty) replaces the default map, as in earlier versions of the chart

removed.description: Removed: the chart fails and names the key that replaces it (tesk.removedValues in templates/_helpers.tpl)

nameOverride.description: Replaces the chart name (tesk) in the names of the objects and in the label app.kubernetes.io/name

fullnameOverride.description: Replaces the prefix of the names of the objects (by default derived from the release name)

hostName.description: Host name (FQDN) of the API, for the Ingress or the OpenShift Route

storage.description: Storage backend that the chart sets up: s3, openstack, or anything else for none

storageClass.description: Storage class of the tasks' PVCs; empty uses the cluster's default class

image.description: Image of the API: a map of repository, tag and pull policy (a string, the form of earlier versions of the chart, fails in the templates with a hint)

port.description: Port of the API's container and Service

tesApiBasePath.description: Base path of the TES API

securityContext.description: Security context of the executors' pods: the fields that tesk-api reads

runAsUser.description: User ID of the executors' containers

runAsGroup.description: Primary group ID of the executors' containers

fsGroup.description: Group that owns the pod's volumes (e.g., the task's PVC), for volume types whose ownership Kubernetes manages

runAsNonRoot.description: Refuse to start executors that would run as root

executorRetries.description: Retries of an executor's job on errors

filerRetries.description: Retries of a filer's job on errors

filerHttpTimeout.description: Timeout of the filer's HTTP(S) requests, in seconds (connecting and each read), up to 1000000; empty uses the filer's default

keepFailedPvcs.description: Keep the PVCs of tasks that fail or are cancelled (true or false; empty is false); by default, the taskmaster deletes them

taskTtlSeconds.description: Seconds after which Kubernetes deletes a finished task's jobs (0 to 2147483647); empty or null keeps them

maxQueueSeconds.description: Seconds that a pod of a task may wait for a node before the task fails (1 to 2147483647); empty or null waits forever

resources.description: Resources of the API's container (requests and limits)

startupProbe.description: The startup probe of the API's container (fields of a Kubernetes probe, and enabled), merged with the chart's defaults

readinessProbe.description: The readiness probe of the API's container (fields of a Kubernetes probe, and enabled), merged with the chart's defaults

livenessProbe.description: The liveness probe of the API's container (fields of a Kubernetes probe, and enabled), merged with the chart's defaults

securityContext.description: Security context of the API's container (fields of a Kubernetes SecurityContext), merged with the defaults; null removes it; its key enabled (of earlier versions of the chart) is listed as removed, but as the map is open, only the templates reject it

swaggerUi.description: Swagger UI of the API (enabled: true or false); the templates check the values

podSecurityContext.description: Security context of the API's pod (fields of a Kubernetes PodSecurityContext), merged with the defaults; null removes it

enabled.description: Support for file: URLs on a shared PVC

wesBasePath.description: Path where the workflow engine sees the shared volume

tesBasePath.description: Path where the filer mounts the shared PVC

mode.description: auth requires OIDC access tokens; noauth leaves all endpoints open

envSubgroup.description: Subgroup of the base group for this deployment

envBaseGroup.description: Base group of the LS Login group model that grants access

serviceInfoPublic.description: With mode auth, whether GET /service-info answers without a token

legacyUserLabels.description: With mode auth, whether tasks created by tesk-api before 1.2.0 are matched to their creators by their old creator label

claim.description: With mode auth: authorisation without groups, by a claim of the user info (tesk-api docs/access-control.md)

enabled.description: Whether users with one of the values in the claim are authorised without groups

name.description: Name of the claim in the user info, e.g., eduperson_entitlement

values.description: Values of the claim, one of which a user needs (compared exactly); non-blank, without commas

clientId.description: ID of the OIDC client of the Swagger UI

clientSecret.description: Deprecated: secret of the OIDC client of the Swagger UI, ignored by tesk-api 1.2.0 and later (the Swagger UI is a public client); only passed on to older tesk-api images

type.description: Type of the API's Service: NodePort, LoadBalancer, or empty for ClusterIP

classicFtpSecret.description: Name of the secret with the FTP username and password; null uses <prefix>-ftp, empty creates none

netrcSecret.description: Name of the secret with a .netrc file; empty creates none

hosts.description: Hosts (host or host:port, without user information, path, whitespace or empty port) that the FTP credentials of classicFtpSecret are sent to; empty sends them to no host

hostIp.description: IP of an FTP server outside the cluster, as pods see the host

enabled.description: Creates an Ingress; false creates an OpenShift Route instead, on OpenShift

className.description: Ingress class; empty uses the cluster's default class

path.description: Path of the Ingress, and the context path of the API

tlsSecretName.description: Secret with the TLS certificate of hostName; empty switches TLS off

global.description: Global values, which Helm passes on to all charts; the chart reads none

enabled.description: Set by parent charts that include this one with condition: tesk.enabled; the chart reads none
